The 1942–43 season was [[List of Real Madrid CF seasons|Real Madrid Club de Fútbol's 40th season]] in existence and the club's [[La Liga|11th consecutive season]] in the top flight of Spanish football.

==Summary==
The club had the third worst campaign ever, finishing 10th and avoiding relegation by just one single point.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.mundodeportivo.com/futbol/el-clasico-barca-real-madrid/20181028/452598877310/la-tercera-peor-clasificacion-de-la-historia-del-real-madrid.html|title=The Third Worst Season in Real Madrid History|publisher=mundeportivo.com|date=28 October 2018|author=Oscar Zarate|language=Spanish|accessdate=10 December 2020}}</ref> Head coach [[Juan Armet]] "Kinké" was fired on round 12 after a bad streak of results,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.marca.com/blogs/ni-mas-ni-menos/2018/04/21/kinke-el-catalan-que-invento-la-escuela.html|title=Kinke The Catalan who invented The School|work=Marca|location=Spain|date=21 April 2018|accessdate=21 November 2020|language=Spanish}}</ref> then after one match with Pablo Hernandez Coronado managing another lost game, the executive board appointed [[Ramon Encinas]] with the main goal of avoiding relegation, which he successfully accomplished.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.marca.com/claro-mx/futbol-internacional/la-liga/2018/10/30/5bd8a1aee2704e60828b466b.html|work=Marca|location=Spain|title=When Changing A Coach Works Out|date=30 October 2018|accessdate=10 December 2020|author=Luis Alberto Diaz|language=Spanish}}</ref>

After having remained in the first category aimed by the goals of [[Manuel Alday]], which included an emphatic 7–0 victory over [[RCD Espanyol|Español]],<ref>{{cite web|title=Alday tumbó al Español en el abultado 7–0 de 1943|url=http://futbol.as.com/futbol/2015/04/07/primera/1428365257_608722.html|publisher=as.com|accessdate=11 June 2015|language=Spanish|date=7 April 2015}}</ref> the squad advanced rounds in the [[1943 Copa del Generalísimo]], where it fared far better, reaching the semi-finals and meeting archrivals [[FC Barcelona]] there. In the first leg of the series the club lost 0–3 but then, on 13 June 1943, the squad [[Real Madrid v FC Barcelona (1943 Copa del Generalísimo)|defeated Barcelona with a colossal 11–1 scoreline]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://as.com/futbol/2016/06/13/mas_futbol/1465798496_463610.html|publisher=as.com|title=The Arrival of Santiago Bernabéu|date=13 June 2016|accessdate=13 November 2020|language=Spanish}}</ref> being in fact the most landslide result in [[El Clásico]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://as.com/futbol/2020/06/12/primera/1591996614_559704.html|publisher=as.com|title=77 Years Ago of That 11–1 against Barca|date=13 June 2020|accessdate=13 November 2020|language=Spanish}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.abc.es/deportes/real-madrid/abci-intrahistoria-mayor-goleada-clasico-201810250326_noticia.html|work=ABC|location=Spain|title=Behind the 11–1 in El Clásico|date=25 October 2018|accessdate=13 December 2020|language=Spanish}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Real Madrid v Barcelona: six of the best 'El Clásico'|url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/competitions/la-liga/8946213/Real-Madrid-v-Barcelona-six-of-the-best-Clasicos.html|work=The Daily Telegraph|accessdate=19 December 2011|date=9 December 2011|location=London|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111219102109/http://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/competitions/la-liga/8946213/Real-Madrid-v-Barcelona-six-of-the-best-El-Clasicos.html|archive-date=19 December 2011}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=A brief history of the Spanish Cup clásico|url=http://www.fcbarcelona.com/football/first-team/detail/article/a-brief-hisotry-of-the-spanish-cup-clasico|date=22 December 2015|access-date=22 December 2015}}</ref> In the [[1943 Copa del Generalísimo Final|final]], the squad was defeated 1–0 by [[Athletic Bilbao|Atletico Bilbao]] with a [[Telmo Zarra]] extra time goal.
